_note: Curated from pylint-odoo v8.x for Odoo v15. v15: still OWL v1 (verified: addons/web/static/lib/owl/owl.js reports version "1.4.11", identical to v14; OWL v2 does not land until v16, where owl.js reports "2.8.2") - do not read this file as an OWL v2 boundary, new asset bundle system mandatory, `create_multi` (`@api.model_create_multi`, present since v12) is the preferred create pattern. `flush()` and `invalidate_cache()` coexist unchanged at v15 (both present verbatim v14-v16); `invalidate_cache()` is not actually removed until v17 - do not read this as a v15 replacement. `web.Widget` should be replaced with OWL components - the legacy Widget module moves under static/src/legacy/ starting v15 (was static/src/js/ at v14), consistent with this recommendation. ESLint from `addons/web/tooling/_eslintrc.json` (verified path; `addons/web/static/src/.eslintrc` does not exist at any indexed version - the first real ESLint config lands at v15 under tooling/, not static/src/).

rules.rule_id_collision: real pylint-odoo 'context-overridden': Context overridden using dict. Better using kwargs `with_context(**%s)`.
rules.message: XML id reference does not match any declared id in the module or its dependencies.
Translation string uses positional `%s` formatting — use named `%(name)s`.
Translatable string concatenation — do not split translatable strings across `+` operators.
File declared in manifest `data` list does not exist.
Built-in dynamic expression interpreter used with external input — use `odoo.tools.safe_eval` instead.
`sudo()` called without restricting scope — avoid broad `sudo()` for entire CRUD operations.

Hardcoded company or currency ID — use `self.env.company` or `self.env.user.company_id`.

rules.message: `unlink()` override does not call `super()`.
`invalidate_cache()` deprecated in v15 — use `flush_recordset()` or `invalidate_recordset()`.
`web.Widget` class used — prefer OWL components in v15+.
rules.fix_template: Migrate to an OWL component: `class MyWidget extends Component { static template = xml`...`; }`

rules.message: N+1 ORM query in loop: `browse()` or `search()` called inside a `for` loop over records.
Computed field missing `@api.depends` decorator — will never be recomputed automatically.
`search()` method override must return a recordset and call `super()`.
Many2one field missing `ondelete` parameter — defaults to 'set null' which may leave orphan references.
`digits=(16, 2)` tuple format deprecated — use a precision field name string.
`copy=True` set on a field with a unique SQL constraint — duplication will fail.
`default_get()` override does not call `super()` — default values from other modules will be lost.
`_sql_constraints` entry message is not wrapped in `_()` for translation.
`fields.Html` field without `sanitize=True` may allow XSS — verify sanitization is intentional.
`_order` attribute references a field that does not exist in the model.
Static assets declared via `qweb` key — use `assets` key with bundle names in v15+.
XPath `position='replace'` removes the target element entirely — verify this is intentional.
View inheritance without `inherit_id` — `<record model='ir.ui.view'>` missing `inherit_id` field.
OWL component class not registered via `registry` — component will not be accessible.
OWL component uses deprecated lifecycle hook `mounted` — use `onMounted` hook.
rules.fix_template: At v15 (still OWL v1), use `owl.hooks.onMounted` (e.g. `const { onMounted } = owl.hooks;`) inside the `setup()` method; the flat `import { onMounted } from "@odoo/owl"` form is a v16+ OWL v2 pattern.

rules.message: `_sql_constraints` entry uses invalid constraint type or malformed tuple.
Unexpected `var`. Use `let` or `const` instead.
Unexpected `console` statement in production JS.
Reference to undeclared variable.
Variable declared but never used.
OWL template references a component not imported.
Use of restricted global — prefer Odoo module-scoped equivalents.
Blind exception: do not catch `Exception` without re-raising or logging.
Line too long (exceeds max line length).
Import block is unsorted or has wrong grouping.
Module imported but unused.
Possible SQL injection risk - string interpolation used in SQL query. Use parameterized queries instead.
